title: Artwork context menu
description: A bounded context menu rotates, inverts and duplicates the artwork it belongs to.
useCase: Provide local commands whose consequences are visible on the selected asset.
interaction: Right-click or tap an artwork, use the three-dot button, or press Shift+F10. Rotate, invert ink or duplicate; each copy remains independently editable.
reducedMotion: Finite transitions become immediate under reduced motion and keyboard input. Host pause disables controls; any owned drag is cancelled.
limitations: Original SVG artwork and at most two local objects; no filesystem writes or clipboard actions. Rotation and ink inversion apply to the selected object only.
look: Cool grey page with a pale file window whose dotted artboard holds a cream square printed with bold cobalt geometric shapes.
motion: Clicking or right-clicking the artwork opens a menu at the pointer that fades and scales up from 0.97 in 150 ms; rotation eases 90° in 280 ms, copies slide in.
adapt: The menu is placed by `open`, which maps pointer coordinates into the 600-unit stage and clamps them, and animates with `sf-context-menu` (150 ms); rotation is the `Stamp` transform with a 280 ms transition. Replace `Stamp` and the three `menuitem` actions with your own.
